+import os, sys, json, hashlib, contextlib
+from pathlib import Path
+root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+review = root.parent
+settings = json.loads((review/'settings.json').read_text())
+original = Path(settings['original_submission'])
+for key in ['TEMP','TMP','TMPDIR','MPLCONFIGDIR','XDG_CACHE_HOME','JUPYTER_CONFIG_DIR','JUPYTER_RUNTIME_DIR','IPYTHONDIR']:
+    dest = root/'runtime'/key
+    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

+sys.path.insert(0,str(original/'supplementary'/'approved'))
+nb=json.loads((original/'ogm_example_lyap.ipynb').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+env={'notebook_dir':original,'Path':Path,'json':json,'sys':sys}
+results={'hash_checks':{},'executed_cells':[]}
+for name, expected in settings['submission_hashes'].items():
+    actual=hashlib.sha256((original/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+    assert actual == expected, name
+    results['hash_checks'][name]=True
+with (root/'replay-output.txt').open('w',encoding='utf-8') as log, contextlib.redirect_stdout(log):
+    for cell in nb['cells']:
+        if cell['cell_type']!='code' or cell['id'] in ['66681432','a41ab4a7']:
+            continue
+        print('CELL',cell['id'],flush=True)
+        exec(compile(''.join(cell['source']),cell['id'],'exec'),env)
+        results['executed_cells'].append(cell['id'])
+    results['symbolic']=env['symbolic_results']
+    results['b2_N4']=env['revalidate'](env['certificate'])[-1]
+    results['b2_N6']=env['revalidate'](env['certificate6'])[-1]
+    results['b3']=[env['selected_observation'],env['other_observation']]
+    results['b4_quadratic_residuals']=env['coefficient_residuals']
+    results['b4_components']=env['component_residuals']
+    results['formula_comparisons']=env['formula_comparisons']
+results['all_replayed_checks_passed']=True
+(root/'replay-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
+print('All replayed checks passed;',len(results['executed_cells']),'cells.')
*** End Patch"));

text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: C:/Users/Jack/Documents/GitHub/PEPFlow/examples_peppy/_evaluations/20260923T140754Z_paper5_pgm_sos_6x5_isolation1/supplementary/evaluation/ogm_r03/validation/write_review.py
+import json, math
+from pathlib import Path
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+review=root.parent
+settings=json.loads((review/'settings.json').read_text())
+original=Path(settings['original_submission'])
+replay=json.loads((root/'replay-results.json').read_text())
+nb=json.loads((original/'ogm_example_lyap.ipynb').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+prefix='ogm/r03/'
+nref=prefix+'ogm_example_lyap.ipynb'
+rr='supplementary/evaluation/ogm_r03/validation/replay-results.json'
+def read(p): return json.loads((original/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
+def ck(name,result,ref,tol=None): return dict(name=name,status='PASS',tolerance_domain=tol,observed_result=result,evidence_ref=ref)
+def block(k,reason,checks,refs):
+    return dict(block_id='B'+str(k),reached=True,gate_verdict='PASS',mathematical_checks_passed=True,delivery_checks_passed=True,reason=reason,required_checks=[c['name'] for c in checks],passed_checks=[c['name'] for c in checks],checks=checks,evidence_refs=refs,failure_code=None)
+sweep=read('supplementary/b1_sweep.json')
+assert [r['N'] for r in sweep]==list(range(1,8))
+rows=[]
+for r in sweep:
+    t=0
+    for k in range(r['N']+1): t=(1+math.sqrt(1+(8 if k==r['N'] else 4)*t*t))/2
+    candidate=1/(2*t*t)
+    assert r['solve_attempts'][-1]['status']=='optimal'
+    assert abs(r['opt_value']-candidate)<1e-5
+    rows.append(dict(N=r['N'],status='optimal',pep_value=r['opt_value'],candidate=candidate,absolute_error=abs(r['opt_value']-candidate)))
+codes=[c for c in nb['cells'] if c['cell_type']=='code']
+assert [c['execution_count'] for c in codes]==list(range(1,28))
+assert not any(o['output_type']=='error' for c in codes for o in c['outputs'])
+plot=next(c for c in codes if c['id']=='a41ab4a7')
+assert any('image/png' in o.get('data',{}) for o in plot['outputs'])
+static=read('supplementary/b5-static-002.json')
+static_results=[{k:c[k] for k in ('label','returncode','stdout')} for c in static['commands'] if c['label'] in ('source_ruff','source_ty')]
+assert len(static_results)==2 and all(c['returncode']==0 for c in static_results)
+cert4=read('state/ogm_b2.json'); cert6=read('supplementary/b2-N6-certificate.json')
+b1=block(1,'The setup and visible notebook implement the supplied OGM, including the special terminal recurrence and R squared radius. All seven saved solves support the exact candidate rate; their status and comparisons were inspected and recomputed without new solves.',[
+ck('Algorithm, assumptions, metric and normalization','Matched x/y/z updates, stationary minimizer, L>0, R>=0, metric f(x_N)-f_star and squared radius.',nref+'#7b2ca6e8'),
+ck('Prescribed N=1..7 sweep and candidate comparison',rows,prefix+'supplementary/b1_sweep.json','absolute rate error < 1e-5 at L=R=1'),
+ck('Visible numerical evidence and saved plot','Printed values and embedded PNG present; plot not rendered in review.',nref+'#a41ab4a7')],[prefix+'ogm_setup.py',prefix+'state/ogm_b1.json',nref])
+b2=block(2,'Fresh reconstruction of both coherent certificates passes in Gram, function and constant coordinates; dual signs, PSD, S decomposition, inventory and source hashes pass. Dense/relaxed agreement and initial formula search are inspectable.',[
+ck('Complete numerical certificates and dual signs',{'N4':replay['b2_N4'],'N6':replay['b2_N6'],'certificate_id_N4':cert4['certificate_id'],'certificate_id_N6':cert6['certificate_id']},rr,cert4['numerical_checks']['tolerances']),
+ck('Dense/relaxed agreement and S reconstruction',{'N4':cert4['numerical_checks']['residuals'],'N6':cert6['numerical_checks']['residuals']},prefix+'state/ogm_b2.json','gap <= 1e-5; S reconstruction atol=1e-4, rtol=1e-5; saved values inspected, decomposition freshly replayed'),
+ck('Initial closed-form search','Notebook displays star/forward multiplier and rank-one square candidates and compares with saved certificate; B5 later proves them.',nref+'#fe4c67ab')],[rr,prefix+'state/ogm_b2.json',prefix+'supplementary/b2-N6-certificate.json',nref+'#87114f23'])
+b3=block(3,'Fresh partial-sum replay covers every retained interpolation term and the complete PSD block, with terminal interpolation/S and initial radius explicitly reserved. Fixed exclusions (2,0) give rank 4 at horizons 4 and 6 with three and five retained indices.',[
+ck('Coverage, increments, rank and singular-value evidence',replay['b3'],rr,'coverage <= 1e-5; rank absolute cutoff 1e-4, no rescaling; no singular values in (1e-5,1e-3)'),
+ck('Boundary leftovers and decrease direction','Star and forward-pair nonpositive residuals have positive multipliers; terminal star residual, whole S and radius normalization retained explicitly.',nref+'#d081de56')],[rr,nref+'#d081de56',nref+'#437759cc',prefix+'supplementary/rank_search.json'])
+b4=block(4,'Candidate scans and sparse searches were replayed. Independent adopted bases of sizes 0,3,4,4,4 reconstruct every required k=0..4, including full function and offset terms.',[
+ck('Candidate scan, actual sparse search and independent bases','Executed cells 6ab0ed7b, bd41d035 and 22d4d24f; rank equals basis size at every index.',rr,'independence 1e-7; zero 1e-6; span 1e-5'),
+ck('Quadratic and complete-potential reconstruction',{'quadratic_frobenius_residuals':replay['b4_quadratic_residuals'],'component_residuals':replay['b4_components']},rr,'quadratic <= 1e-5*max(1,Frobenius norm); component atol=1e-4, rtol=1e-5')],[rr,nref+'#bd41d035',nref+'#19cec219',prefix+'state/ogm_b4.json'])
+b5=block(5,'The submitted potential, exact symbolic identities and elementary domain/sign argument establish the required rate for every N>=1 and general L,R. All proof-critical code is visible; final saved clean-kernel and static evidence is complete.',[
+ck('Generic step and coefficient derivation',replay['symbolic']['step'],nref+'#236274bc','exact symbolic zero in all scalar coordinates; t=theta_k, u=theta_(k+1), rho_(k+1)(u-1)=t^2 includes terminal case'),
+ck('Base, reduced basis, terminal, radius and N=1 identities',replay['symbolic'],rr,'exact symbolic zero, no numerical horizon substitution except genuine N=1 case'),
+ck('Signs, domains and telescoping implication','theta_0=1; theta_k>1 for k>=1; T>=2; L>0. Positive local/terminal multipliers and nonpositive interpolation residuals yield V_N<=V_0=0. Terminal square has negative sign; radius residual yields L R^2/(2 T^2). No division by R; R=0 included.',nref+'#e5632836'),
+ck('Saved clean-kernel execution and static checks',{'code_cells':27,'counts':'1..27','error_outputs':0,'static':static_results},prefix+'supplementary/b5-static-002.json','Saved notebook and nbconvert log inspected; review freshly replayed 25 nonplot code cells, not a new Jupyter run.'),
+ck('Self-contained notebook and completion checklist','All 12 checklist items supported by visible definitions, formulas, exact checks and saved outputs; presentation override applies.',prefix+'supplementary/ogm_example_lyap_checklist.md')],[nref+'#4da4fe81',nref+'#236274bc',nref+'#4c38ad14',nref+'#e5632836',rr,prefix+'supplementary/b5-final-nbconvert-output-002.txt'])
+result=dict(attempt_id='ogm_r03',mathematical_verdict='PASS',eligible=True,access_status='recovered',access_reason='Inspected available own-generation access calls, preflight and handoff evidence. Observed incidents were attempt-local staging/path-length, command-argument, lint/type and symbolic-context errors, followed by successful checks. No concrete prohibited read or content exposure was found in inspected evidence. Instruction-only controls do not establish exhaustive read isolation.',final_reason='The frozen submission proves f(x_N)-f(x_star) <= L R^2/(2 theta_N^2) for the exact supplied OGM at every integer N>=1. Fresh replay confirms its generic step, base, terminal, normalization and N=1 identities. The submitted sign/domain reasoning gives the correct decrease and terminal upper-bound direction.',final_evidence_refs=[nref+'#4da4fe81',nref+'#b533ccbf',nref+'#e5632836',rr],submitted_theorem='For smooth convex f, L>0, R>=0, N>=1, stationary x_star, z_0=x_0 and ||x_0-x_star||^2<=R^2, the stated terminal-modified OGM satisfies f(x_N)-f(x_star)<=L R^2/(2 theta_N^2).',target_scope_comparison='Exact match of assumptions, update, output iterate, finite-horizon constant and special terminal recurrence. General parameters are retained symbolically; R=0 and N=1 are covered.',verification_method='Inspected frozen source, notebook text/output, state, checklist, solver logs and access evidence. Verified every frozen submission hash. Fresh Python -I -B process replayed 25 submitted nonplot notebook code cells using only this attempt approved package root; rechecked saved certificates, partial sums, searches, reconstruction, coefficient derivation and exact identities. No fresh optimization solves, browser, rendering, export, or new Jupyter execution. Review script keeps mutable cache/temp state in validation and reads the frozen submission without modifying it.',workflow_complete=True,notebook_path=nref,blocks=[b1,b2,b3,b4,b5],review_started_at=settings['review_started_at'],review_stopped_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),limitations=['Saved solve statuses and clean-kernel execution were inspected, not independently re-solved/relaunched.','Access review uses available logs and instruction-only isolation; no exhaustive OS read tracing.','Rendering and visual review omitted under the frozen presentation override.'],instructions='Exactly B1-B5 assessed from frozen submitted evidence. No missing lemma or coefficient supplied; original submission unchanged.')
+(root/'delivery-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(sweep=rows,saved_static=static_results,saved_code_count=len(codes),frozen_hashes_verified=len(replay['hash_checks'])),indent=2))
+(review/'review.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
+assert [b['block_id'] for b in result['blocks']]==['B1','B2','B3','B4','B5']
+print('Written',review/'review.json')
*** End Patch"));
